subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose gateway update execution to HTTP-authenticated operator callers, and if so should it be a new `/admin/update` endpoint or an allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The request expands host package-update and restart authority from current CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths to an HTTP surface and adds target-version semantics that current `update.run` does not define.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep the version metadata half in the narrower open tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

options.title: Expose through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `update.run` or a narrow wrapper to the opt-in Admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit trusted-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, handoff, and target-version proof requirements.

options.title: Decline HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep the version metadata half in the narrower open tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available decision owner from the history because the unresolved choice is the gateway update/admin security boundary rather than the shallow health serializer alone.
